definitions.gloss: mutual understanding; communication; getting on the same page
definitions.explanation: The process of conveying one's intentions and understanding another's, resulting in shared comprehension. Emphasizes the two-way nature of communication and whether both parties truly understand each other.

notes: Composed of ⟦{意思|いし}→意思：12742_ishi⟧ (intention, will) + ⟦{疎通|そつう}→疎通：18049_sotsuu⟧ (mutual understanding, free flow). The most common collocation is {意思疎通|いしそつう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{図|はか}る→図る：12006_hakaru⟧ (to seek/attempt mutual understanding). Also: {意思疎通|いしそつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れる→取れる：02376_toreru⟧ (to be able to communicate), {意思疎通|いしそつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧ (there is a lack of communication). A formal, slightly stiff word often used in business and organizational contexts. More casual alternatives: ⟦コミュニケーション→コミュニケーション：08425_komyunikeeshon⟧, ⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}い→話し合い：14176_hanashiai⟧ (discussion).
